flags.reason: The Portfolio Hero guide (e7ed622) says it was checked on 28 October 2026 on the 27 October build, the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02, but that publish changed only the screen-reader sentence (#346); #403's fix to PortfolioHero.tsx (ace46ca, then dbe0e02; blob 8907545 on c8526ae, d1a9deb installed) is not in the guide. Read against the installed source and its tokens through the package's resolver, three guide statements no longer hold, and the entry leaves them out: (1) States “… and it has no action: Figma’s Action Slot, an icon button beside the amount, isn’t in the package.” and Sources “the package has a fixed label and amount, children for the slot, and no action.”: the package now has topSlot, which replaces or hides the product label, and actionSlot, showAction and onActionPress, which put a control beside the amount (by default a 42 px Icon Button toggle, Emphasis Low, AppearanceBrand Neutral, named “Card”), plus actionActive, actionAccessibilityLabel and accessibilityLabel (PortfolioHero.tsx lines 53–78, 160–189, 210–216); the States title “No states of its own” goes with it, since the default action keeps its own on and off state. (2) Configuration “Slot gap spaces them.” and the Slot gap cards (“Slot gap L … 24 px.”): the slot now reads portfolioHero/slotWrap/gap (line 123), which is 8 px in every Slot gap mode, so Slot gap L leaves 8 px between the badge and the note. (3) In context “the hero has no button of its own”: true of the guide's example, not of the package. Also out of date in the evidence: the Contract's slot/gap and Slot gap lines, “No testID, onPress, accessibility props, or top-area slot”, the Discrepancies' Action Slot / Top Slot and “Unused tokens” lines, and the Limits' “Don't imply the hero presses, has an action button, replaces the chip, …, or that screen readers announce the amount” (on dbe0e02 the amount is announced once, #346). #403 is still In progress for its height item alone. The guide changes when #403 is closed and published (the stale sentences are listed in a note on #403); then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r24, for Marcin to confirm.

configuration.text: topSlot replaces the product label (the avatar and label); false, '' or null hide it. Leave topSlot out to keep the label.
actionSlot puts your own control beside the amount; false, '' or null hide it. Without actionSlot, showAction or onActionPress shows the default action: a 42 px Neutral Low IconButton.
The default action is a toggle: left without actionActive it switches itself on and off when pressed; pass actionActive to set its state from the screen.

examples.purpose: The top of a holding's page, the guide's In context: the hero opens the Gold page with the product's logo, the holding's value, and under the amount a Badge with the change (its leading ic_card Icon on Context4 Badge, as the Badge entry says) and a Text with one fact; the holding's details follow in a ListGroup of List Items, and the two actions sit below: Buy keeps the defaults and Sell takes Emphasis Medium. The URI stands for the product's logo image, value for the holding's current value (Buy and Sell change it), and each onPress for the screen buying or selling ₹1,000.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <VStack>
    <PortfolioHero
      label="Gold"
      imageSource={{ uri: 'https://example.com/logos/gold.png' }}
      value="12,000.11"
    >
      <Badge
        label="+₹2,722.45 (+22.5%)"
        leading={<Icon iconName="ic_card" modes={{ Context4: 'Badge' }} accessibilityElementsHidden importantForAccessibility="no" />}
      />
      <Text text="Worth 1.23g Gold" />
    </PortfolioHero>
    <ListGroup>
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Gold in your locker" supportText="1.23 g · 24K, 99.9% pure" navArrow={false} />
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Average buy price" supportText="₹7,544 a gram" navArrow={false} />
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Today’s price" supportText="₹9,756 a gram" navArrow={false} />
    </ListGroup>
  </VStack>
  <HStack>
    <Button label="Sell ₹1,000" modes={{ Emphasis: 'Medium' }} onPress={() => {}} />
    <Button label="Buy ₹1,000" onPress={() => {}} />
  </HStack>
</VStack>

from.quote: The hero opens the Gold page, the holding’s details follow in a list, and the two actions sit at the bottom.

examples.purpose: A holding that lost value, the guide's Down card: the change goes in a Badge with Semantic Intent System and AppearanceSystem negative, and its leading Icon takes the same modes with Context4 Badge. The URI stands for the product's logo image, and the figures for the holding's value and its change.
examples.jsx:
<PortfolioHero
  label="Mutual Funds"
  imageSource={{ uri: 'https://example.com/logos/mutual-funds.png' }}
  value="1,45,230.50"
>
  <Badge
    label="−₹1,204.10 (−0.8%)"
    modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }}
    leading={<Icon iconName="ic_card" modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative', Context4: 'Badge' }} accessibilityElementsHidden importantForAccessibility="no" />}
  />
</PortfolioHero>

from.quote: The Badge’s Semantic Intent System, AppearanceSystem negative.

props.name: label
props.description: Product label text displayed next to the avatar. Default "Gold", from the component source.

props.name: imageSource
props.description: Without imageSource there is no avatar and no placeholder. Declared: Image source for the product avatar.

props.name: value
props.description: Monetary value to display. Default "12,000.11", from the component source.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol or ISO code. Default "₹", from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes configuration mapped to Figma tokens.

props.name: children
props.description: Slot content rendered below the money value (e.g. Badge, subtitle).

props.name: topSlot
props.description: Replaces the Product Label chip when given. `false`, `''` and `null` hide the chip. Omit the prop to keep the default label.

props.name: actionSlot
props.description: Custom control beside the amount. `false`, `''` and `null` hide the action. When omitted, `showAction` or `onActionPress` can still show the default 42 px Neutral Low IconButton.

props.name: showAction
props.description: Show the default action next to the amount.

props.name: onActionPress
props.description: Press handler for the default action button.

props.name: actionIconName
props.description: Icon for the default action. Defaults to `ic_card`. Default "ic_card", from the component source.

props.name: actionAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the default action. Defaults from `actionIconName` (`ic_card` is "Card").

props.name: actionActive
props.description: On/off state of the default toggle. Omit it and the button toggles itself when pressed. Pass it to control the state from outside.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: With accessibilityLabel the hero is a group named by it; without one the hero does not group its children. Declared: Optional accessible name for the hero region.

modes.name: Avatar Size
modes.description: With imageSource, Avatar Size sets the logo: L 42, M 36, S 29 px or XS 14 px. The hero's default is S, a 29 px logo. Declared: A token collection PortfolioHero reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: The amount sits on a 44 px line, so the hero is taller than Figma's 159 px (Component Bug #403).
Figma shows the Jio logo by default; the package shows an avatar only when imageSource is set.
